title_as_printed: (no caption; text: examples of the water vapor densities obtained from the condensation points in the pvt experiments)
property_description: Water density (g H2O per cc of vapour) of the CO2-H2O vapour phase at the condensation (dew) point in the pvt experiments, with the water partial pressure pw = P - pi; pi = initial CO2 pressure (atm) charged into the vessel before water injection. Rows with pi = 0 are pure water checks. Overall composition in these runs about 5 mol% CO2 (text p. 56, for tables 3 and 4).
pressure_note: pi = initial CO2 pressure in the dry vessel at T (atm); P = total pressure at the condensation point (not printed); pw = P - pi (atm). The text assumes CO2 and steam pressures are additive.

value.what: mass of water per volume of the saturated vapour at the condensation point

value2.what: density of pure saturated steam at T (source not named; Dorsey 1940 used elsewhere)

pw.what: measured total pressure at condensation point minus pi; '-' = not given

p0w.what: normal saturation pressure of pure steam

conversion_needs: Water content as g H2O per cm3 of vapour; converting to y_H2O needs the CO2 amount in the vapour (not printed).
Rows with pi = 0 (329 C, 260 C) are pure-water runs (gas-free).
notes: Authors: steam densities unlikely more accurate than +-5 percent. Printed em dash in the pw column of the 370 row written as '-'. Rows kept in printed order (not monotonic in T).
